name: Lilfynia Haidopair
original_name: リルフィニア・ハイドパイル
source:
Lilfynia is the daughter of [url=/c44905]Akbar Gill Clift[/url], who fought in the war 20 years ago with [url=/c96498]Felix Haidopair[/url]. She became Felix's wife after the war, and has been working with him to rebuild Haidopair. 

Lilfynia likes [url=/c96489]Blanche[/url] because of her loyalty to fulfilling her duties.
